name: Leyline Tyrant
oracle_text:
Flying
You don't lose unspent red mana as steps and phases end.
When this creature dies, you may pay any amount of {R}. When you do, it deals that much damage to any target.
blocked_sentences: When this creature dies, you may pay any amount of {R}. When you do, it deals that much damage to any target.

needs.what: an optional mid-resolution payment of a player-chosen number N of one coloured symbol ({R} N times), announced like may.x and bound with `as` so a reflexive trigger can read N -- 'you may pay any amount of {R}. When you do, it deals that much damage'
needs.why_existing_wont_do: may.x announces the X of a {X} pay, and ManaCost.with_x adds X as generic mana, so red-only cannot be required; pay.times scales a fixed cost by a value the card computes, not one the player chooses, and is refused beside x; repeat paying {R} once per loop is several separate payments with no count to bind and would split the damage into several events. The mana_retention line is expressible (mana_retention static, colors ["R"])
